name: bisect
description: Find the module that breaks Hideout: from safe mode the hub starts half of what Start normally would start, counts a close without a clean exit as 'closed' and 5 minutes open as 'fine', starts the next round after a close only on a click, and names the module once it was on alone in a round that closed. The saved enabled set is never edited until the result's choice.

steps.event: enabled set = [a,b,c,d,e,f] (placeholder ids, no provider links: 6 entries); hub is in safe mode
user chooses Find the module that breaks Hideout
the hub closes without a clean exit (run\hub-run.json still marks it running); it starts again in safe mode with nothing on
5 minutes pass with the hub open and the PC awake
the hub closes without a clean exit

offers: Go back to <Module> <previous> (only when an older version is kept)
